name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.7 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 10 times in 5 visits over 41 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 15 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 41 hours starting 2025-06-06, at wavelengths from 0.84 to 3.09 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
